_comments: THE OUTBOUND DISPATCH ACTION (#293). Its own dot-json so parallel work on other actions conflicts on nothing.
WHY AN ACTION. Outbound events are recorded inside the transaction that caused them and sent after it. MJ's
scheduler dispatches Actions, and this row is how the minute job reaches DispatchOutboundDeliveries. The class
behind it holds no delivery logic.
SAFE TO SHIP Active: with no consumer registered there are no delivery rows, and a pass claims nothing.

fields.Name: Dispatch Outbound Events
fields.Description: Send the outbound events that are due (order confirmations and entitlement grant changes) to the consumers registered for them. Failed deliveries are retried with backoff and dead-lettered after their deadline.
fields.UserPrompt: Send the outbound events that are due to their consumers.

fields.Name: MaxCount
fields.Description: Cap on deliveries claimed in one pass (default 50). Rows left over are sent on the next pass. A value that is not a whole number of at least 1 is refused.

fields.Name: Claimed
fields.Description: How many due deliveries this pass took.

fields.Name: Delivered
fields.Description: How many were accepted by their consumer.

fields.Name: Retrying
fields.Description: How many failed and were scheduled to be tried again.

fields.Name: DeadLettered
fields.Description: How many failed past their deadline and were dead-lettered.
